description: The bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance of RoBERTa models with different fine-tuning methods and sizes. The x-axis represents the fine-tuning methods, which include Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model. The y-axis measures the GLUE performance, ranging from approximately 84 to 88. There are two sets of bars for each method, indicating the performance of the base and large RoBERTa models. The base model generally shows lower performance compared to the large model across all fine-tuning methods. The S5-model appears to have the highest performance for both model sizes, while the Prefix method has the lowest performance for the base model. The chart does not include any annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
